title: Do you know the muffin man?
description: Did you ever want to become The Muffin Man? well now you can!
body:
“**_Do you know the muffin man_**?” is a simple mod adding muffins to minecraft. The muffins that are in the mod are “Chocolate Muffin” and “Carrot Muffin”. They  can be crafted with bread on the bottom middle slot and wheat on either side of it with coco bean/golden carrot on top of the bread.
I plan on adding more muffins later such as; “Sculk Muffin,” “Nether Muffin,” etc.
